---
title: "Principle 2: Catalog available data"
citation: false
format:
  html: default
---

- Identify all datasets available for your region or spatial domain.
- For each dataset, catalog the relevant details including:
  - Data formats and any transformations/pre-processing that have been conducted
  - Variables or metrics available
  - Spatial and temporal resolution
  - Spatial extent and timeframes of data
  - Future scenarios
  - Historical scenarios
  - Models and corresponding ensemble members
  - Downscaling and bias-adjustment approaches
- Review existing metadata for each dataset including:
  - Approach for dataset development
  - Limitations of the dataset
  - Frequency of dataset updates
  - Accessibility and transparency of methods
- Identify the availability of user guidance for each dataset.
- Identify any relevant regulations, policies, or guidelines related to data use for your region or sectoral application (e.g. guidance on which models, metrics, or scenarios to use).
